item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create ONE five-shot photo montage using ALL FIVE supplied photo references in exactly this order. 0-1 seconds: @dog golden retriever sitting on park grass, subtle breathing and gentle push-in. 1-2 seconds: @cat surprised tabby cat on gray sofa, tiny ear motion and subtle camera push-in. 2-3 seconds: @friends smiling adult pair at beach, ocean waves move softly behind them. 3-4 seconds: @woman adult woman in gray sweater at park, subtle natural blink and breeze in hair. 4-5 seconds: @lake calm alpine lake and mountains, subtle water ripples. Use clean cuts between these five distinct shots, not morphing. Preserve each reference's subjects, identities, clothing, setting and composition closely. Show every photo clearly, fit full photographs within the widescreen canvas where needed rather than cropping out subjects. Warm cohesive natural photographic look, restrained realistic motion. No added people, no text, no logos, no speech.
